ManagerList.ManagerProvidedBiography:
Mitesh is an Index Research Analyst/Portfolio Manager within the Global Equity Beta Solutions Group in London. He joined SSGA as a part of 2015 cohort of the Global Graduate Rotational Program, during which he contributed to the equity, fixed income and multi asset quantitative research groups. Prior to SSGA, he had over ten years of professional experience spread across the investment team of endowment funds such as DUMAC and KIMC and prime brokerage teams at Nomura, Lehman Brothers, and Citi.
Mitesh holds a Master of Business Administration from the Fuqua School of Business at Duke University and a Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics from The Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda, India. He is a CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) and FRM (Financial Risk Manager) charter-holder.
